opening.argument: The video promotes registration in a Forsage Ethereum smart-contract program and directs viewers to message a listed number to join. It then presents an escalating sequence of ETH amounts as something that can be generated “over and over again an unlimited amount of times.” The payment structure reinforces that pitch: payments from the first two X3 spots go to a participant’s ETH wallet, while the third spot reopens the slot and sends payment to an upline. This is a recruitment-commission and tiered-matrix scheme presented through repeatable earnings claims and routed participant payments. The record does not establish completed transfers or actual withdrawals, and it does not show who controls the contact number; those limits do not alter what the video promotes.
